display_long_description:
Step into a fully immersive VR world where survival meets prehistoric danger. In Dinosaur Prehistoric Hunter VR, you'll explore a beautifully crafted jungle filled with 9 deadly dinosaur species including the legendary T-Rex and fast, aggressive raptors. Each dinosaur has lifelike animations and intelligent AI they chase, attack, and fight back.
Armed with powerful weapons like the MP5, shotgun, handgun, bow and arrow, and even a sword, you’ll experience intense close-range and long-range combat. Yes, you can kill dinosaurs with a sword or take them down silently with arrows. The game delivers intense action, whether you're sneaking through underbrush or standing your ground in a firefight.
With realistic graphics, immersive 3D audio, and dynamic environments, the game makes every moment feel real. Multiple game modes including Survival and Free Hunt are built for Meta Quest’s intuitive VR controls. 

Features:

1)9 unique and aggressive dinosaur species
2)T-Rex, raptors, and other realistic predator behaviors
3)Weapons include MP5, shotgun, handgun, bow & arrow, and sword
4)Close-range dinosaur combat (yes, you can sword-fight a dinosaur!)
5)Stunning visuals with highly detailed jungle environments
6)True 3D sound and spatial audio
7)Survival Mode, Free Hunt Mode & more
8)Fully optimized for Meta Quest VR
9)Advanced dinosaur AI  they chase, fight, and corner you
10)Immersive hand controls with smooth locomotion
11)No tutorials needed  jump straight into the action
